title: Keeping villages alive
instructions:
You must answer this question. Write your answer in 220-260 words in an appropriate style.

Your class has listened to a radio programme about young people leaving the countryside for big cities. You have made the notes below.

Write an essay discussing two of the measures in your notes. You should explain which measure would do more to persuade young people to stay in rural areas, giving reasons to support your view.

You may use the opinions from the programme if you wish, but express them in your own words as far as possible.
inputText:
What could encourage young people to stay in rural areas?

Opinions expressed in the programme:
'Without a fast internet connection, nobody can work from a village.'
'If the last bus leaves at six, young people feel trapped.'
'Young couples simply cannot afford the houses that are for sale.'
